public_rationale: The retrieved evidence does not establish the claimed financing dependence across all the named companies and every neocloud. limitations: Neither substantial exposure nor diversified demand alone settles causal dependence.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: The future growth of Amazon, Google and Microsoft, and also of Oracle, CoreWeave and every other neocloud, depends on Anthropic and OpenAI continuing to be able to raise money and having the demand needed to spend it.

statement.excerpt: And let’s be clear about something: the future growth trajectories of Amazon, Google and Microsoft (not to mention Oracle, CoreWeave, and every other neocloud) are contingent on the continued ability for Anthropic and OpenAI to raise and have the demand necessary to spend that money.

our_interpretation: The ordinary reading is that expected corporate growth materially depends on financing and spending by the two labs, not that every business line requires their payments.
Assess the claimed dependency in growth expectations at publication. This is a causal claim about projections, rather than a forecast of a particular financing failure.
The reference to every neocloud is broad and must not be established from CoreWeave alone.
No numerical definition of growth trajectory or material dependence is supplied. Do not invent a percentage cutoff.
criteria.support_condition: Customer-level forecasts and financing sensitivity analyses show that losing the labs' funding or demand would prevent the expected growth trajectories across the named companies and the broader neocloud class.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Credible customer-level forecasts or observed substitutions establish that expected growth can be maintained independently of the labs' continued funding and spending for a material part of the asserted scope.
